source: procedural (numpy), generated for Vitals on 2026-10-23 (vitals-research/grain/gen.py, candidate d)
method: seamless film grain: per-pixel Gaussian white noise (numpy default_rng seed 20261023), a periodic Gaussian blur of sigma 0.35 px and a soft low cut (wavelengths above ~16 px attenuated by 75 %), both in the frequency domain so the tile wraps without a seam; normalised to mean 31.2 and standard deviation 6.7 on 0-255 (the Lumen grain's tone). No clump layer, so it cannot mottle.
encoding: 512x512 RGB, lossless WebP (method 6): no compression blocks
replaces: the 2026-10-18 tile (sigma 0.7 + sigma 2.0 clumps, 768 px), whose 3-6 px blotches read as felt, under a flat tint gradient whose ordered dither read as a weave
role: The desktop sidebar tile (--lm-grain-sidebar, src/styles/shell.css). Drawn at one image pixel per device pixel (src/app/grain.ts).
